court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before R. Subbiah and C. Saravanan, JJ.)
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. R. Thanjan No appearance
For Respondents: Mr. V. Shanmuga Sundar Special Government Pleader [R1 to R4 & R7]
judgment_text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of The Constitution of India praying for the issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing respondents, particularly, respondents 1 to 6, including the seventh respondent to take necessary action for permanent stoppage of the stone crushing unit set up by respondents 8 and 9 at Mampudhur Village, Uthiramerur Taluk, Kancheepuram District, comprised in Survey No. 191/1C2, 4 and 1D2 on the basis of petitioner's representation dated 31.12.2018.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Subbiah, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing on 13.08.2019, there was no representation for petitioner and hence, Registry was directed to list the matter under the caption ‘for dismissal’ on 16.08.2019. Even today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, there is no representation for petitioner. Hence, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
